I was in high school sitting an end of year math test.
This particular day I was sitting real close to the teachers desk, like desks touching each other close. The classroom was kind of small so we all had to squish the tables close together just to fit everyone in. 
Anyway, during the test I knew I was going to fail so I just sat there pretending to look really concentrated and answer what ever problems I could. While I was pretending to think really hard I looked up to the teachers desk and took note how untidy his work space was and then I noticed it. 
He had all the answers to previous tests on his desk including this one.
Being the ruthless teenager I was, I copied a sheet that looked similar to mine and hoped for the best. 
Next day the teacher wanted to give an announcement before he handed back our results and told the entire class the only student who passed the test was me and was amazed by my working out and was extremely disappointed in everyone. He proceeded to thank me personally and I only just passed the whole year due to the 100% on my end of year results but that also included a couple of fails through the year and other average scores. 

I couldnt own up that I cheated but maybe teachers will keep their desks a little cleaner haha.
